svg.title: r(x) = (2x² − 8)/(x² + 1) levels off at y = 2
svg.desc: The graph of r(x) = (2x² − 8)/(x² + 1). Its zeros are x = −2 and x = 2 and its y-intercept is (0, −8). For large positive and negative x the graph gets close to the dashed horizontal asymptote y = 2, the quotient of the leading terms 2x²/x².
